name: @trekmail/mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for TrekMail. Exposes 189 agent tools covering domains, DNS, mailboxes, aliases, forwarding, mail filters, auto-reply, sieve, migrations, SMTP, tickets, account, billing, spam stats, email verifier, Cloudflare DNS, Drive (files + sync-device passwords), and the full webmail surface (messages, attachments, drafts, scheduled send, contacts, calendar, identities, templates, blocked senders).
author: TrekGuider Inc.
